title: The Fight for Britain’s Right: Can Kemi Badenoch Reboot the Conservatives?
summary: Attendees at the party’s annual conference have been buoyed: both by leader Kemi Badenoch’s rising poll ratings and a mock Bayeux Tapestry. But the challenge from Reform U.K. remains.
